title: Minimax solutions of path-dependent Hamilton--Jacobi equations under weakened assumptions with application to differential games
summary: We study minimax (generalized) solutions of a Cauchy problem for a (first-order) path-dependent Hamilton--Jacobi equation with co-invariant derivatives under a right-end boundary condition. Under assumptions on the Hamiltonian that are more general than those previously considered in the literature and allow, in particular, a measurable dependence on the first (time) variable, we establish existence, uniqueness, stability, and consistency results for minimax solutions.
